school: New York University (NYU Grossman School of Medicine)
program: PhD in Biomedical Sciences - Computational Biology and Bioinformatics training area (Vilcek Institute of Graduate Biomedical Sciences)

requirements.quote: To apply, you must have at least a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from a college or university of recognized standing, with a strong background in biological, chemical, physical, or mathematical sciences.

problems: This is a Vilcek Institute PhD in Biomedical Sciences admissions statement covering all training areas. The Computational Biology and Bioinformatics training-area page states no prerequisites.
No specific math courses are named. Mathematical sciences is one of four alternative backgrounds. The same paragraph says 'We have no minimum GPA requirement and welcome all academic majors.'
